launch_evidence.quote: $0.6 million of net sales of LOQTORZI which began shipping to distributors in December 2023 in preparation for launch

series_start_reason: First sales were distributor shipments in December 2023 (2023Q4, $0.6 million); Coherus dates the commercial launch to January 2, 2024 ('commercial launch commencing on January 2, 2024', same release). 2023Q4 is kept as the first quarter of revenue and launch_quarter is set to it.
search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1512762 via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent plus older pages, all forms incl. 8-K/A); selected 8-K/8-K/A filings with Item 2.02 from 2023-10-01 and searched every document in each (index.json) for 'loqtorzi'.

Each quarter read from the quarter's own earnings release (Exhibit 99.1) sentence stating LOQTORZI net sales/net revenue for that quarter; January preliminary-results presentations (2024-01-10, 2025-01-13, 2026-01-13) not used.

Checks: 2024 quarters 2.0+3.8+5.8+7.5 = 19.1, equal to 'LOQTORZI net product sales in FY 2024 were $19.1 million' (2025-03-10 release); 2025 quarters 7.3+10.0+11.2+12.4 = 40.9 vs 'LOQTORZI net revenue more than doubled to $40.8 million' (2026-03-09 release), within rounding of the one-decimal quarterly figures.
Verifier run on staging: every row's label and figures found on one line of its cited document.
